feature: AtmosFlow API handlers boot under plain Node
_comment: Stand-alone wrapper for `npm run accept:api-boot` (CI job `api-boot`). The same API-BOOT criterion is also part of prod-ready.json and go-live.json.

criteria.label: Every api/** entry bundles with esbuild (node, esm, packages external) and imports under plain Node with a function default export
criteria._comment: The runtime shape that failed in the CHANGELOG incident: vitest, lint, typecheck and the grep gates were all green while 24 extension-less imports took every affected route to 500 at cold start. The check also refuses any relative ESM import without a file extension at resolve time (CLAUDE.md pitfall #4).
